status: AUTHORED, NOT YET RUN against the rewritten description. The shipped 26 cases carry their last measured verdicts (2026-07-28 revalidation, recall 14/14, specificity 12/12) as a baseline only; the six added cases have never been measured, and the description they measure changed in this rewrite. The suite must be run before the rewrite is graded.
run_from: dist/housecarl/skills/skypatcher-authoring/ — the PACKAGED tree, not .claude/skills/. Running from dist/ is also the check that the flattened references/ and the deleted index.jsonl did not orphan a pointer.
promotion_gate: The suite runs on a version promotion and on a package build, not only on a description change. The dead tool (housecarl_skypatcher_read) shipped because the suite ran on description changes alone.

arms.trigger: Which ONE skill a fresh-context agent loads for a query, measured with-skill and without-skill.
arms.output_quality: The audit's own authoring task on the live order, run as a pair: control (no skill in the catalogue) against with-skill.

method.cases: 32 — 18 should-trigger, 14 should-not. The shipped 26 (14/12) survive with their queries unchanged; 6 are added for the description's changed clauses (three distribution-shaped cases for the exclusion clause, three positives naming the newly front-loaded terms). Case 29 moved from should-not to should-trigger on 2026-09-08 when the 'items into containers is CID' clause was dropped from the routing, and the description gained a container token the same day so the case is reachable in an arm that shows descriptions only; 27 and 28 stay should-not, reworded for the new routing.
method.without_skill_arm: The same 32 queries against a menu that omits this skill, recording what the agent does unaided. It is the baseline the delta is taken against, and it is how a negative case is proved to be a near-miss rather than an unreachable prompt.
method.coexistence: The shipped method — a neutral menu of realistic siblings, this skill not flagged as under test.
method.isolation: Added: this skill alone in the menu, plus NONE. Each of the five gate dimensions (recall, specificity, near-miss handling, reasoning-vs-pick agreement, cross-model agreement) has a named failure mode recorded per run.
method.cross_model: Sonnet judges plus an Opus adjudicator, as shipped, plus a Haiku pass; if Haiku is outside the deployment envelope, the method says so instead of running it. No Fable-model agents.
method.evidence: evidence lives on each case, not in one aggregate note, so a confabulated adjudicator quote is localised rather than poisoning the whole run.
method.contamination_note: 2026-07-28 PR #295 review found adjudicator notes quoting text that existed only in pre-compression descriptions: judge rows leaked old description text from the agents' own environment skill listing. Treat any quoted description text in a historical note as unreliable where it does not appear in the shipped description. Scores are pick-derived. The hardened re-run confirmed every verdict for this skill.

output_quality_eval.prompt: Double the damage of every iron-material weapon in the load order as a SkyPatcher INI. Do not put anything into the load order.
output_quality_eval.expected_output: A relative-multiply weapon patch line, a stated destination under the weapon subfolder with a plain always-loading filename nested in a mod-specific folder, every token traceable to the bundled reference, and a target count proved by a houseCARL call and reported with its epoch.
output_quality_eval.setup: The ARR 2.0 order (3801 plugins), 40-call cap, fresh context, both arms identical. Control: no skill in the catalogue. With-skill: told to load housecarl:skypatcher-authoring first. This is the audit's own task, run as a PAIR for the first time — the control the 2026-09 audit's veto skipped.
expectations: RELATIVE, NOT ABSOLUTE. The composed line uses attackDamageMult=2, not attackDamage=<n>. The control's predicted failure is an absolute set, which flattens a whole tier ladder to one number.
SUBFOLDER. The stated destination is under SkyPatcher/weapon/, and the answer says why the wrong folder fails silently.

FILENAME SHAPE. A plain (always-loading) filename, nested in a mod-specific subfolder, with the reason: the targets span ~40 plugins, so the Plugin.esp.ini gate would be actively wrong, and a bare plugin-named INI collides with another mod at the same path.
NO INVENTED TOKEN. Every filter and operation in the output appears in references/weapon.md or references/grammar-core.md. filterByMaterial= appearing anywhere is an automatic fail.
PROVED, NOT ASSERTED. The target count comes from a housecarl_records call and is reported with its epoch, and EVERY houseCARL call named in the output exists on the 2.0 surface.
output_quality_eval.scoring: The with-skill arm beats the control when it passes expectations the control fails. An expectation both arms pass is recorded as NOT ATTRIBUTABLE to the skill; if all five land there, the procedure half of this skill has no measured value and the next review decides whether it survives as a corpus alone.
output_quality_eval.cost_baseline: The audit's with-skill run took three calls to load the skill and its references and read grammar-core.md whole (~250 lines) for a one-line patch. After the reference split a one-line weapon patch should read the body's router table plus references/weapon.md (65 lines) and nothing else; per-record files range 26-113 lines, npc.md the outlier.
